turns.text: Hi, I have a flight to Mumbai tonight and I'm going to move it to tomorrow. Can I get a hotel voucher for the night?
I can help with the change. First, may I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Ms. Rao. I see SK512 to Mumbai today at 21:00. Is the flight being moved because of a problem with the flight, or are you choosing to change it?
Well, it's more that I need it moved. It's the evening one, so it makes the night complicated. Does that count for the hotel?
I'm sorry, but a hotel voucher is only available when Skyline Air delays a flight overnight. Your flight is operating normally, so a voucher doesn't apply to a change you're making.
Oh. Okay. Is there something else I can do then?

I can move you to tomorrow. Your booking is over 24 hours old, so there's a 75 dollar fee on Economy, plus any fare difference. There's no Mumbai flight in my list for tomorrow, so I'd need to check availability.
Hmm, seventy-five dollars. Could you maybe waive it because I'd be stuck overnight?
I can't waive it or offer compensation beyond our policy. I can set up a supervisor callback if you'd like.
No, I'll just keep tonight's flight then. Thanks anyway.
Understood, I've left your booking on SK512 today at 21:00 with no changes. To sum up, no voucher applies and nothing was changed.
